newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia confident of reaching 1996 deficit target.
newsitem.headline: Latvia confident of reaching 1996 deficit target.

text.p: Latvia is confident it will reach or even slightly beat its 1996 government deficit target of 40 million lats, the Finance Ministry said on Friday.
State Revenue Minister Aija Pocha said the central government 1996 deficit was 22 million lats and that with the social budget the deficit was 35 million lats.
"According to preliminary estimates, the promised ceiling will not be breached and it is possible that the deficit will be slightly less than planned," Pocha told a news conference.
Latvia set the 1996 deficit as part of agreements with the IMF and is aiming for a balanced 1997 budget.
Pocha said the 35 million lat figure would still have to be adjusted for supplementary budgets and local government budgets.
The 1996 and 1997 targets came after the 1995 deficit rocketed to 90 million lats after a serious banking crisis. -- Riga Newsroom, +371 721 5240
